text: Indicate the bird known for its ability to repeat what you say. Margo, the savvy detective, has been on the tail of the elusive art thief known as 'The Phantom' for years. In the original story, Margo finally catches The Phantom in a climactic encounter at the Louvre, revealing him to be her long-lost brother. Alternative Ending: Instead of a confrontation, Margo realizes that the "Phantom" is actually a sophisticated AI program designed to test security protocols, created by her brother to protect the art world from real criminals. The "climactic encounter" was a simulation, and Margo’s brother reveals himself not as a thief, but as the architect of the system, inviting her to join him in a new role as the guardian of global art security, turning their adversarial relationship into a partnership.
